title: Ν. 4548/2018 Αναμόρφωση του δικαίου των ανωνύμων εταιρειών, άρθρα 151 έως 154 (μη χρηματοοικονομική κατάσταση, ενοποιημένη μη χρηματοοικονομική κατάσταση), as published
evidence: Άρθρο 190 Έναρξη ισχύος: «Η ισχύς του παρόντος νόμου αρχίζει την 1η Ιανουαρίου 2019, εκτός αν ειδικώς ορίζεται διαφορετικά.» (ΦΕΚ Α΄ 104/13.06.2018, read as PDF from https://api.et.gr/apiFEK/1/2018/104/pdf on 2026-11-02). Articles 151 to 154 carry no commencement clause of their own.
notes: NFRD transposition (non-financial statement). Record text is the run of the gazette text from the heading of Article 151 to the heading of Article 155 (Articles 151, 152, 153, 154; the brief named 151 and 154, and 152 and 153 sit between them), cut at the headings, page headers of the gazette left in. Article 151 was replaced and Article 154 was replaced by Articles 7 and 9 of Ν. 5164/2024 (gr-law-5164-2024, in force 2024-12-12); the amended wording of 4548/2018 is not stored as a separate version because et.gr serves gazette issues only and no official consolidated text of Ν. 4548/2018 was found (kodiko.gr and e-nomothesia.gr are private services and are not used). Article 190 of the original gazette also says some provisions start on other dates; Article 185 starts a different part on 2018-05-31 and does not touch Articles 151 to 154. Greek only: Greek is the only official language; no government English text was found on api.et.gr, search.et.gr or www.et.gr (all Greek; www.et.gr/en answers 301), and the Hellenic Parliament site refused the cloud address (403).

title: Ν. 5164/2024 Ενσωμάτωση της Οδηγίας (ΕΕ) 2022/2464 (CSRD) και της κατ' εξουσιοδότηση Οδηγίας (ΕΕ) 2023/2775, as published
evidence: Άρθρο 84 παρ. 1: «Η ισχύς του παρόντος αρχίζει από τη δημοσίευσή του στην Εφημερίδα της Κυβερνήσεως, εκτός αν ορίζεται διαφορετικά στις επιμέρους διατάξεις.» Gazette dated 12 Δεκεμβρίου 2024 (ΦΕΚ Α΄ 202/12.12.2024), read as PDF from https://api.et.gr/apiFEK/1/2024/202/pdf on 2026-11-02.
notes: Number, gazette and date confirmed from the gazette itself. Record text is the whole gazette issue (all Parts A to H). Article 77 starts on 2025-01-01 (Article 84 para 2). Article 14 sets which financial years the sustainability reporting duties of Chapter A apply to (from 2024-01-01 for large public-interest entities above 500 employees); Article 50 sets 2024-01-01 for Part C. Article 7 replaces Article 151 and Article 9 replaces Article 154 of Ν. 4548/2018. Article 92 of Ν. 5172/2025 (ΦΕΚ Α΄ 2025, a violence-against-women act, not in scope) adds a transitional rule on who may assure the sustainability reports for financial year 2024; it was found in the text of that act and is not stored. No Greek act transposing the stop-the-clock Directive (EU) 2025/794 was found on official pages. Greek only; no government English text found on api.et.gr, search.et.gr or www.et.gr.

title: Ν. 5317/2026 Ενδυνάμωση της προστασίας των καταναλωτών ... Ενσωμάτωση των Οδηγιών (ΕΕ) 2017/828, 2023/2225, 2023/2673, 2024/825, 2024/1799 και 2026/74, as published (Part C: Directive (EU) 2024/825, empowering consumers for the green transition)
evidence: Άρθρο 143 παρ. 1: «Με την επιφύλαξη των παρ. 2, 3 και 4, η ισχύς του παρόντος νόμου αρχίζει από τη δημοσίευσή του στην Εφημερίδα της Κυβερνήσεως, εκτός αν ορίζεται διαφορετικά στις επιμέρους διατάξεις του.» Part Γ΄ (Directive 2024/825) is not named in paras 2 to 4. Gazette dated 10 Ιουλίου 2026 (ΦΕΚ Α΄ 108/10.07.2026), read as PDF from https://api.et.gr/apiFEK/1/2026/108/pdf on 2026-11-02.
notes: Transposes Directive (EU) 2024/825. Part Γ΄ (Articles 79 to 90) amends Ν. 2251/1994 Articles 1α, 3β, 3δ, 4, adds 4στα, amends the unfair-practice Articles 9α, 9δ, 9ε and 9στ (Articles 86 to 89) and amends 13α (Article 90). In force date: the brief expected the Directive's application date 2026-09-27; the Greek text names no such date. Article 143 para 1 gives publication, 2026-07-10, and the text of Part Γ΄ was searched for 27 September 2026 and has no match, so 2026-07-10 is used and the gap is reported. Parts A (credit agreements) apply from 2026-11-20 and Part Δ΄ from 2026-07-31 (Article 143 paras 2 and 3). Record text is the whole gazette issue (all Parts, 438,000 characters), because the gazette is the unit the publisher serves. Greek only; no government English text found on api.et.gr, search.et.gr or www.et.gr.
